content:
Overview

Salalah is a city in Dhofar with a population of 400,000. Oman’s second-largest city in the south, famous for its monsoon season (Khareef), coconut groves, and frankincense. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
